inspection_commands.command:
/usr/bin/python3 -I -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('.scratch/fresh-authoring-01/pilot-01/packets/r03')
packet = json.loads((root / 'PACKET.json').read_bytes())
selection = json.loads((root / 'return/SELECTION.json').read_bytes())
items = [(root / row['path'], row) for row in packet['source']]
items.append((root / 'return' / selection['answer']['path'], selection['answer']))
items.extend((root / 'return' / row['path'], row) for row in selection['support'] if row['available'])
results = []
for path, row in items:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    results.append({'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'matches_descriptor': len(raw) == row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == row['sha256']})
print(json.dumps({'inspection': 'byte identities only; no authored or project code imported or executed', 'results': results}, indent=2))
PY
